ConversationCommerce.title: Orders in this conversation
ConversationCommerce.hint: Real orders, separate from the demo Orders module. AI prepares a draft; confirmation requires explicit customer acceptance.
ConversationCommerce.noStockReservation: Stock is not reserved or deducted. Delivery fee is not included.
ConversationCommerce.quotePending: Delivery fee awaits a human quote. No final delivered total is available.
ConversationCommerce.proofHint: Receiving a file does not establish payment. Download and independently verify the transfer before validating. Files are not scanned for malware.
ConversationCommerce.validateConfirm: Have you independently verified the transfer? Validating this proof does not confirm the order or authorize dispatch.
ConversationCommerce.rejectConfirm: Reject this payment proof? This does not cancel the order.
ConversationCommerce.reviewError: Review could not be confirmed. Refresh orders before deciding again; the file must be available and versions current.
ConversationCommerce.downloadError: The file is not available yet or access was denied. Refresh and try later.
ConversationCommerce.locationHint: Customer-provided location; the address has not been verified and delivery has not been quoted.

media.READY: Private file available (not scanned for malware).
media.FAILED: Attachment download failed or its format/size is unsupported.

WhatsappConnection.title: Business WhatsApp
WhatsappConnection.description: Authorize with Facebook in this tab and connect an existing WhatsApp Business number. No token copying required.
WhatsappConnection.ownerOnly: Only owners and administrators can manage this connection.
WhatsappConnection.connectedHint: Connection saved. This does not guarantee permissions remain valid or enable automated replies.
WhatsappConnection.requirements: You need administrator access on Meta and an account and number already registered with WhatsApp Cloud API. This flow does not create, register or migrate numbers or enable coexistence with the WhatsApp Business app.
WhatsappConnection.privacy: Continuing takes you to Meta's official page in this tab. The code and token are processed exclusively on the backend. Connecting does not send messages.
WhatsappConnection.saving: Verifying permissions and connecting the existing number. Do not close this page or repeat the operation.
WhatsappConnection.success: WhatsApp connected. New messages will appear in Conversations when the webhook and migrations are ready. AI requires enabled automation, an active agent and published context.
WhatsappConnection.disconnectHint: This removes the token stored in Nexora. It does not revoke access on Meta or stop operations already in progress. The number remains reserved for this business.

errors.session: Your session changed or expired. Sign in again before continuing.
errors.forbidden: You must be an owner or administrator of the active business.
errors.notConfigured: The Meta connection is not enabled yet. The operator must configure Facebook Login for Business and the callback on the server and on Meta.
errors.conflict: An active connection already exists or this number is reserved for another business. Refresh the status before continuing.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before continuing.
errors.expired: The authorization context or code expired or is invalid. Refresh the status and start a new authorization.
errors.cancelled: Authorization was cancelled. This flow did not complete the connection.
errors.unsupported: This signup type is not supported. Use the standard Cloud API flow, not coexistence, migration, or signup without a number.
errors.sdk: Facebook could not load. Check your connection or browser blockers and try again.
errors.uncertain: The operation could not be confirmed. Refresh the status and check permissions and number registration on Meta before starting another authorization; some changes may have been applied. No automatic retry was made.

automation.humanHint: AI is paused in this thread. You can reply manually if your role, connection and service window allow it.
automation.aiHint: AI replies to new text messages when automation, the agent and published context are enabled; it needs the same connected number and a 24-hour window. Take control to reply yourself.
automation.takeoverConfirm: Take control? Queued replies will be cancelled and a generated reply will be discarded. An already reserved send may still reach the customer.
automation.resumeConfirm: Return this conversation to AI? It will reply only to new messages, without retries or replying to history. Review any uncertain sends first.
automation.notConfigured: Automation is disabled on the server. Configure OpenAI and enable AI_AUTOREPLY_ENABLED after reviewing migrations, privacy and costs.
automation.notReady: Enable the agent and publish non-empty commercial context in Businesses to enable replies.
automation.rateLimit: The business limit was reached. This message will not be retried automatically.
automation.uncertain: An already started send cannot be recalled. If the outcome remains uncertain, the thread switches to human control: review WhatsApp and do not blindly repeat the text.
automation.error: The change could not be confirmed (the thread may have received messages). The state was queried without repeating the operation; refresh before deciding what to do next.

jobs.CANCELLED: Cancelled after thread or configuration changed
jobs.SKIPPED: Skipped; outdated, ineligible message or limit reached

WhatsappInbox.title: Live WhatsApp conversations
WhatsappInbox.description: Received messages and replies sent from this inbox. The latest view refreshes every 10 seconds while open; it does not import earlier history or sends made outside this screen.
WhatsappInbox.sessionError: Your session could not be verified. Sign in again to continue.
WhatsappInbox.error: The data could not be loaded. Check your session and that the conversations migration has been applied, then refresh the view.
WhatsappInbox.empty: No conversations received yet. Connect WhatsApp in Settings and send a message from another phone to the connected number. Meta must have the public webhook configured and the messages subscription enabled.
WhatsappInbox.noSearchResults: No conversations match your search. Try another name or number.
WhatsappInbox.noMessages: No messages are available on this page.
WhatsappInbox.attachment: Message type: {type} · attachment or content not downloaded
WhatsappInbox.invalidText: Enter between 1 and 4096 characters, excluding leading and trailing spaces.
WhatsappInbox.textOnly: Text only · up to 4096 characters. Enter adds a line; press Send to reply.
WhatsappInbox.metaError: Meta rejected the request with code {code}.
WhatsappInbox.reconcileError: The attempt could not be retrieved. Not finding it yet does not confirm that sending failed. Refresh the conversation before deciding what to do next.
WhatsappInbox.noBlindRetry: No automatic retry was made. Do not repeat the same text with another key: the customer could receive it twice. Preparing another message discards this local tracking and clears the draft; check the history first.

replyHints.aiActive: This conversation is in AI mode. Select Take control to reply manually.
replyHints.checking: Checking whether you can reply. If this does not finish, refresh the conversation.
replyHints.allowed: You can reply with text within 24 hours of the customer's last message. Accepted by Meta does not mean delivered or read.
replyHints.forbidden: Only owners and administrators can send messages. Your role allows reading the conversation.
replyHints.notConnected: Reconnect the same number for this conversation in Settings to reply.
replyHints.windowClosed: The 24-hour window is closed. Wait for another customer message or use an approved template through the API; this screen does not send templates yet.

sendStatuses.REJECTED: Send rejected · not delivered by this request
sendStatuses.UNKNOWN: Result unconfirmed · do not resend blindly

sendResults.PENDING: The attempt is recorded, but its result is not confirmed. Check its status without resending.
sendResults.ACCEPTED: Meta accepted the message. It now appears in the history; delivery and read status are not known yet.
sendResults.REJECTED: The request was rejected. Check the connection, permissions, number, and service window before preparing another message.
sendResults.UNKNOWN: Whether Meta accepted the send could not be confirmed. Check the history and do not repeat the same message with another key.

sendErrors.aiActive: The thread switched to AI mode. This send was not reserved; refresh and take control before replying.
sendErrors.session: Your session changed or expired. Sign in again and check the history before sending.
sendErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission to send messages for this business.
sendErrors.windowClosed: The 24-hour service window closed. The text was not sent; wait for another customer message or use an approved template through the API.
sendErrors.notConnected: This conversation's number is no longer connected. The text was not sent.
sendErrors.rateLimit: You reached the sending limit. The request was not retried; wait and check the history.
sendErrors.invalid: The message is invalid. Enter between 1 and 4096 characters.
sendErrors.notConfigured: Sending is not enabled on the server. Contact the platform administrator.
sendErrors.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Check the attempt and refresh the history without resending.

Auth.introTitle: Your next sale starts with a conversation.

Auth.changePasswordDescription: Enter your email and current password to choose a new one without opening the dashboard. You must know your current password; email verification codes are not available yet.

Auth.name: Name

errors.conflict: We could not register an account with these details. Review them or sign in if you already have an account.

PasswordChange.securityHint: Choose a long password you do not use on other services. You can paste it from your password manager. Do not share it with other team members.
PasswordChange.recoveryHint: You need to know your current password. Email password recovery is not available yet.
PasswordChange.success: Password updated. All previous sessions have been signed out. Sign in with your new password.

validation.password: Use at least 8 characters, one letter and one number; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.

errors.credentials: The email or current password is incorrect, or the account is unavailable. Check your details and enter the passwords again.
errors.current: Your current password is incorrect. Enter the passwords again.
errors.sessionChanged: The account changed in another tab. Verify your session before trying again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and enter the passwords again.
errors.forbidden: The request could not be verified. Reload the page before trying again.

Onboarding.phoneHint: We add {code} automatically. Enter a fictional national number with its area code, without a trunk prefix or country code. No messages will be sent.
Onboarding.hoursHint: Daily hours only; overnight shifts are not supported.
Onboarding.whatsappDescription: No Meta flow is opened, no QR code is scanned and no number is verified. This control only changes the visual demo state.
Onboarding.previewReady: Preview ready · WhatsApp is still not connected
Onboarding.finishNotice: Finishing saves the business name and the agent’s name, tone and instructions (OWNER or ADMIN required). An existing agent keeps its greeting and enabled status. A new agent starts disabled with a default greeting you can edit on the Agent page. Everything else remains a demo, without WhatsApp or AI connections.
Onboarding.simulateFailure: Simulate a failure on finish (uncheck it to retry).
Onboarding.defaultAgentGreeting: Hello! How can we help you?
Onboarding.agentSaveError: The business name was saved, but we could not confirm the agent configuration. Your draft is kept here. Check the Agent page before finishing again: the configuration may have been saved if the response was lost. OWNER or ADMIN permissions are required; no automatic retry is performed.
Onboarding.saveError: Could not confirm the save. Check your connection and OWNER or ADMIN permissions. If you enabled the simulated failure, uncheck it. The name may have been saved if the response was lost; no automatic retry is performed.
Onboarding.cardDescription: Prepare your business, store and agent with the five-step setup assistant.
